lookup.note: Official source for keys this file does not carry: the U.S. Department of State foreign per diem table (Office of Allowances), published in monthly editions - the site names each edition's publication date and the effective date its rates start. {city} is the post name: the per-diem search returns a list of posts whose View links open the per-diem data; pick the post matching the trip's city and the effective date the source states. Fetched 2026-10-12.

self_employed_note: Self-employed individuals may use the M&IE rate for meals and incidental expenses only; lodging is recorded at actual cost. Rev. Proc. 2019-48 section 4.03.
first_last_day_note: First and last day of travel use the GSA FirstLastDay amount, 75 percent of the M&IE rate.
same_day_note: A trip that starts and ends on the same calendar day has no M&IE per diem: travel away from home is travel long enough to need sleep or rest (Publication 463, chapter 1, Traveling Away From Home). Its meal receipts are shown as recorded.
